info.title: Dow Jones R&C Profile API
info.description: R&C Profile API delivers the capability for clients to retrieve the R&C Assets.

tags.name: Connection Details
tags.description: Operations to retrieve the Connection Details of a R&C Profile

get.description: Get R&C profile given an profile id. It is possible to get only parts of the profile, to reduce response size, using the parts parameter.

get.summary: Get Profile Notes by Profile id
get.description: Get profile notes from a profile given its id.
Get an image given an image reference id.  Can only retrieve one image at a time

get.summary: Get the connection details for a profile
get.description: Get a list of connectionDetails for a given profile ID. It is possible to filter through name, type, connection and icon. It is also possible to get the results ordered and with pagination.

406.description: Not Acceptable - application/json is not supported for this endpoint

FilterValues.description: Returns filter values based on the current values returned by the profile, refreshing its values based on each request.

FilterValuesV27.description: Returns filter values based on the current values returned by the profile, refreshing its values based on each request.

FilterValuesV28.description: Returns filter values based on the current values returned by the profile, refreshing its values based on each request.

ProfileId.name: filter[profile_id]
ProfileId.description: Unique profile id that identifies a profile

Id.name: id
Id.description: Unique id that identities the resource

ProfileParts.name: parts
ProfileParts.description: Specify which parts of the profile to return, can be one or more separated by comma ( , ). If not specified (empty), all assets will be returned

ProfileNotesParts.name: parts
ProfileNotesParts.description: Specify which parts of the profile notes to return, can be one or more separated by comma ( , ). If not specified (empty), all assets will be returned

ProfilesListsDescription.name: has_lists_description
ProfilesListsDescription.description: If true, returns a description for the three lists types (Sanctions List, Other Exclusion List and Other Official Lists), if false, then no description is returned.

IsAudit.name: is_audit
IsAudit.description: (Available from version 2.3+) Boolean flag to control if a request should be auditted of not.

FilterProfileType.name: filter[type]
FilterProfileType.description: Filter by profile type (available up to version 2.6)

FilterProfileTypeCode.name: filter[type_code]
FilterProfileTypeCode.description: Filter by profile type code (available from version 2.7)

FilterConnectionType.name: filter[connection_type]
FilterConnectionType.description: Filter by connection type (available up to version 2.6)

FilterConnectionTypeCode.name: filter[connection_type_code]
FilterConnectionTypeCode.description: Filter by connection type code (available from version 2.7)

ProfileNotesTargetTranslation.name: profile_notes_target_language
ProfileNotesTargetTranslation.description: Specifies the language to translate to using iso-639-1 language code.

TargetLanguage.description: Specifies the language to translate to using iso-639-1 language code.
